name: Wellforce

ahrq.src: AHRQ Compendium of U.S. Health Systems, 2023, matched to CMS's hospital list (the site's June 2026 pull)

hc.src: Medicare hospital cost reports (CMS HCRIS, Worksheet S-3), fiscal year 2024 file

subs: Beds on its Medicare cost report. A licensed bed count usually runs higher.
Every intensive and special care unit counts: adult, cardiac, surgical, burn, neonatal and pediatric.
Each inpatient stay that ended counts once, whoever paid for it.
All inpatient days divided by discharges. Answer in days, like 4.5.
Patient days divided by the bed days it had available.
Medicare Advantage plans included. Counted in days spent in a bed, not in people.
Medicaid managed care plans included. Counted in days spent in a bed, not in people.
Two half-time employees count as one. Hospital payroll only: not clinics, not contract staff.
Interns and residents: doctors training after medical school. Two half-time count as one.
From AHRQ's 2023 list of who owns which hospital, matched to Medicare's hospital list.
Every one of its hospitals' latest Medicare cost report, added up.
Biggest by beds on its cost report. The answer names the hospital.
Two half-time employees count as one. Hospital payrolls only: clinics, offices and any health plan are left out.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Lowell General Hospital have on its payroll in fiscal 2024?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 Wellforce hospitals; Tufts Medical Center has the most, 4,555. About 6.3 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Melrosewakefield Healthcare have on its payroll in fiscal 2024?
questions.why: That is the fewest of 3 Wellforce hospitals; Tufts Medical Center has the most, 4,555. About 8.1 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Tufts Medical Center have on its payroll in fiscal 2024?
questions.why: No other Wellforce hospital reports more; Lowell General Hospital is next at 2,452. About 12.3 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent resident physicians trained at Tufts Medical Center in fiscal 2024?
questions.why: Interns and residents: doctors training after medical school. Two half-time count as one.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees do Wellforce's hospitals have on payroll, added together?
questions.why: From all 3 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2024.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent resident physicians train in Wellforce's hospitals, added together?
questions.why: One of its hospitals reports residents; Tufts Medical Center trains the most, 368.

questions.q: What percent of Lowell General Hospital's inpatient days in fiscal 2024 were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 Wellforce hospitals; Melrosewakefield Healthcare runs highest, 57 percent. Traditional Medicare was 31 percent and Medicare Advantage plans 17 percent.

questions.q: What percent of Melrosewakefield Healthcare's inpatient days in fiscal 2024 were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: No other Wellforce hospital runs higher; Lowell General Hospital is next at 48 percent. Traditional Medicare was 39 percent and Medicare Advantage plans 18 percent.

questions.q: What percent of Tufts Medical Center's inpatient days in fiscal 2024 were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: That is the lowest of 3 Wellforce hospitals; Melrosewakefield Healthcare runs highest, 57 percent. Traditional Medicare was 35 percent and Medicare Advantage plans 11 percent.

questions.q: What percent of Lowell General Hospital's inpatient days in fiscal 2024 were for Medicaid patients?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 Wellforce hospitals; Tufts Medical Center runs highest, 29 percent. Traditional Medicaid was 11 percent and Medicaid managed care plans 14 percent.

questions.q: What percent of Melrosewakefield Healthcare's inpatient days in fiscal 2024 were for Medicaid patients?
questions.why: That is the lowest of 3 Wellforce hospitals; Tufts Medical Center runs highest, 29 percent. Traditional Medicaid was 7 percent and Medicaid managed care plans 7 percent.

questions.q: What percent of Tufts Medical Center's inpatient days in fiscal 2024 were for Medicaid patients?
questions.why: No other Wellforce hospital runs higher; Lowell General Hospital is next at 25 percent. Traditional Medicaid was 13 percent and Medicaid managed care plans 16 percent.

questions.q: Across all of Wellforce's hospitals, what percent of inpatient days were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: Across every U.S. hospital's cost report it is 44 percent.

questions.q: Across all of Wellforce's hospitals, what percent of inpatient days were for Medicaid patients?
questions.why: Across every U.S. hospital's cost report it is 24 percent.

questions.q: How many beds did Lowell General Hospital report to Medicare for fiscal 2024?
questions.why: No other Wellforce hospital reports more; Tufts Medical Center is next at 369 beds.

questions.q: How many beds did Melrosewakefield Healthcare report to Medicare for fiscal 2024?
questions.why: That is the fewest of 3 Wellforce hospitals; Lowell General Hospital has the most, 390 beds.

questions.q: How many beds did Tufts Medical Center report to Medicare for fiscal 2024?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 Wellforce hospitals; Lowell General Hospital has the most, 390 beds.

questions.q: How many intensive care beds did Lowell General Hospital report to Medicare for fiscal 2024?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 Wellforce hospitals; Tufts Medical Center has the most, 106 ICU beds. That is 6 percent of its 390 beds.

questions.q: How many intensive care beds did Melrosewakefield Healthcare report to Medicare for fiscal 2024?
questions.why: That is the fewest of 3 Wellforce hospitals; Tufts Medical Center has the most, 106 ICU beds. That is 14 percent of its 160 beds.

questions.q: How many intensive care beds did Tufts Medical Center report to Medicare for fiscal 2024?
questions.why: No other Wellforce hospital reports more; Lowell General Hospital is next at 23 ICU beds. That is 29 percent of its 369 beds.

questions.q: How many inpatient discharges did Lowell General Hospital report for fiscal 2024?
questions.why: No other Wellforce hospital discharged more; Tufts Medical Center is next at 17,929. About 54 a day.

questions.q: How many inpatient discharges did Melrosewakefield Healthcare report for fiscal 2024?
questions.why: That is the fewest of 3 Wellforce hospitals; Lowell General Hospital discharged the most, 19,838. About 22 a day.

questions.q: How many inpatient discharges did Tufts Medical Center report for fiscal 2024?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 Wellforce hospitals; Lowell General Hospital discharged the most, 19,838. About 49 a day.

questions.q: How many days did the average inpatient stay last at Lowell General Hospital in fiscal 2024?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 Wellforce hospitals; Tufts Medical Center ran longest, 5.9 days. Across the cost reports of U.S. general hospitals it averages 5.0 days.

questions.q: How many days did the average inpatient stay last at Melrosewakefield Healthcare in fiscal 2024?
questions.why: That is the shortest of 3 Wellforce hospitals; Tufts Medical Center ran longest, 5.9 days. Across the cost reports of U.S. general hospitals it averages 5.0 days.

questions.q: How many days did the average inpatient stay last at Tufts Medical Center in fiscal 2024?
questions.why: No other Wellforce hospital kept patients longer; Lowell General Hospital is next at 4.6 days. Across the cost reports of U.S. general hospitals it averages 5.0 days.

questions.q: On an average day in fiscal 2024, what percent of Lowell General Hospital's beds had a patient in them?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 Wellforce hospitals; Tufts Medical Center ran fullest, 78 percent.

questions.q: On an average day in fiscal 2024, what percent of Melrosewakefield Healthcare's beds had a patient in them?
questions.why: That is the emptiest of 3 Wellforce hospitals; Tufts Medical Center ran fullest, 78 percent.

questions.q: On an average day in fiscal 2024, what percent of Tufts Medical Center's beds had a patient in them?
questions.why: No other Wellforce hospital ran fuller; Lowell General Hospital is next at 64 percent.

questions.q: How many hospitals does Wellforce run, by the federal list of health systems?
questions.why: All of them are in Massachusetts. A system's own count can differ: it may count campuses on their own, or hospitals that joined after 2023.

questions.q: How many beds do Wellforce's hospitals report to Medicare, added together?
questions.why: From all 3 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2024.

questions.q: How many beds does Wellforce's biggest hospital report to Medicare?
questions.why: It is Lowell General Hospital. Tufts Medical Center is next, with 369.

questions.q: How many intensive care beds do Wellforce's hospitals report to Medicare, added together?
questions.why: That is 16 percent of their 919 beds. From all 3 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2024.

questions.q: How many inpatient discharges did Wellforce's hospitals report in a year, added together?
questions.why: About 126 a day. From all 3 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2024.
